t: The Decoupling Breakthrough: From Single-Tenant App to Distributable Library
s: This article details the author's journey to simplify Python packaging and decouple a single-tenant application into a distributable library, emphasizing modern `pyproject.toml` workflows and AI ergonomics for enhanced collaboration.
sub: Demystification of modern Python packaging using `pyproject.toml`.
Decoupling a single-tenant application ('Cathedral of One') into a distributable library.
Architecting for AI ergonomics, creating environments AI can easily interact with.
Simplification of the PyPI release process to a three-step procedure.
The transition from 'Cathedral of One' to a distributable, multi-user capable system.
